summary: Example running a dnf install asynchronously with poll 0, waiting on it with async_status using until/retries/delay, then cleaning up the job file.
questions: How do I run a long package install in the background and wait for it later?
How do I poll an async job until it completes?
How do I fire-and-forget a task with async and poll 0?
How do I remove the async result file after waiting?

answer_card.title: Fire-and-forget then wait with async_status
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.dnf: {name: docker-io, state: present}
  async: 1000
  poll: 0
  register: dnf_sleeper

- ansible.builtin.async_status:
    jid: '{{ dnf_sleeper.ansible_job_id }}'
  register: job_result
  until: job_result is finished
  retries: 100
  delay: 10

- ansible.builtin.async_status:
    jid: '{{ dnf_sleeper.ansible_job_id }}'
    mode: cleanup
```
